Guidance & outlook: Our governance framework is designed to drive long term value creation while adhering to best practices and principles.
During FY 2025-26, we made significant progress in expanding our strategic vision through successful vertical integration into the garment manufacturing sector.

Evaluation of Independent Director was based on Participation and Contribution, Guidance provided to the Senior Management, Effective deployment of knowledge and expertise, Independence of behavior and judgment, Maintenance of confidentiality of critical issues, Attendance at the Board/ Committee Meeting.
Growth & demand: This strategic expansion has further strengthened our manufacturing capabilities, enhanced operational efficiency, and positioned the Company to effectively meet growing customer demand while supporting its long-term growth objectives.

These milestones mark a significant step in our growth journey, reinforcing our position as a trusted manufacturing partner in the retail apparel industry while laying a strong foundation for sustainable long-term growth.

In conjunction with the continued growth of the Company 's own apparel brand, TEN BY TWOO, we plan to increase our garment manufacturing capacity by at least 50% in the coming year, ensuring that we are well-equipped to meet the evolving demands of our customers and capitalize on emerging opportunities in the market.
